item.title: Cavan and Monaghan found to be among cheapest counties
item.description: Cavan and Monaghan are among the cheapest counties in Ireland. Cavan, Monaghan, Longford, Roscommon, Leitrim and Donegal were deemed as some of Ireland's cheapest counties when many aspects of life are considered. Saoirse Hanley, a journalist with the Irish Independent, compiled the costs, looking at things like rent, cinema costs, coffee, fitness facilities, GP costs and haircuts. item.title: E-scooters a 'major concern' in Monaghan Town
item.description: A local Aontú representative has shared her concerns over the use of e-scooters in Monaghan Town. Oliva Larkin says despite existing legislation, it is almost impossible to enforce the law onto e-scooter users. The local rep says a number of e-scooter users are choosing to "flaunt the law" and due to this she believes the law should "go further." item.title: Road closed in Carrickmacross after truck overturns
item.description: Emergency services are currently at the scene of a collision in Carrickmacross. A truck has overturned and as shed a load of timber at the Carrickmacross north junction on the N2. Advertisement The junction is currently closed to allow for the clearing of the road. It’s not known at this time if any injuries have reported following the collision. Advertisement Diversions are currently in place and you are being asked to following the signage for the diversion that’s in operation.

item.title: Highest survival rates for breast cancer in Cavan
item.description: Data released to Aontú following a Parliamentary Question reveals significant regional disparities in breast cancer survival rates across Ireland. The highest survival rates for breast cancer is in Cavan at 94% in contrast to the average countrywide figure which is 87.3%. Aontú Senator Sarah O Reilly says while Cavan leads with the most favourable figures, Monaghan reports a survival rate of just 85.4%. item.description: 29 Lotto players across Ireland won prizes worth €1million and above in 2025. In Cavan €19 million was won in three separate wins in the latter part of last year. This included a €17 million EuroMillions jackpot win in December and a top prize Daily Million win in November.
